blocks.html:
Ford F-250 Commercial Truck Decals

Promoting a business is a minefield. With countless ways to advertise or promote a business, it is normal to get confused. Especially when advertising isn’t free or quick. When you’re looking for ways to spread the word about your business there are some factors that affect the decision you end up taking. These include:

  1. What is your target audience? Their shared interests, behaviors, etc?
  2. What kind of business is it that you’re trying to advertise?
  3. How long do you want to keep promoting?
  4. How much are you willing to spend?

Once you have done your research and have the answers to the questions above, you’ll be able to make a better decision. Our recent client Mr. Harley must have done the same to figure out that he wanted to get some promotional decals on his Ford F-250 2017 truck.

Our client figured that vehicle decal would be the best way to promote his business for the following reasons:

  1. Truck Decals are extremely customizable; There is no design that you can not turn into a decal.
  2. Truck Decals last for several years. You get the decals and forget about them.
  3. Vehicle Decals require minimal maintenance.
  4. Truck Decals are very cost-effective considering their lifespan.
  5. In most cases, truck decals are very easy to install and remove for professional installers.
  6. You get to choose from a wide spectrum of available colours and finishes, such as gloss, matte, brushed, etc.

Based on the above-mentioned information about decals, our client reached a decision to get decals to promote his business using all that extra/available real estate on his Ford F-250 2017 Truck.

He contacted our team and explained what he expected out of it. We gathered all the information and created a digital mockup to show him how the decals will look like on his Ford F-250 Truck. Once he approved we started to print and cut the vinyl. Laminated it and passed it to our capable installers. The decals were installed on both sides and back of the Ford F-250 truck, able to be seen from all directions.

We do all of our jobs with great enthusiasm, accuracy and treat our clients’ vehicles with the utmost respect and care.

We have attached pictures of the Ford F-250 truck after getting the decals on this page.

If you are looking to promote your business using your vehicle, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is here to make it happen. Feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.

To read more stories and see more pictures, visit our blog page here. Check out more truck decals here.
